methodology: Three fresh-process synthetic runs per revision and shape, alternating order in a quiet measurement window; metadata generation excluded.
Synthetic total is ingestion plus publication. FULL synchronization and 16,384-page automatic checkpoints remain unchanged from f09e48e.
Five alternating actual-pipeline runs per revision, 2,000 real folders with ten files each; normal overlap of discovery and writer. Overlapping intervals must not be added.
Stale control seeds 40,000 files outside the timer, relists 20,000 retained records, and includes trim, owner reconciliation and publication.
SQL PROFILE SELECT durations are statement lifetimes, not CPU; profile runs are excluded from speed comparisons.
Warm local filesystem and existing swap; no cold-disk, UI, whole-Mac or concurrent-mutation throughput claim. Sampled WAL maxima are not hard size caps.

profile_counts.note: SQL PROFILE durations include statement lifetimes, especially SELECTs left at ROW; not CPU. Only VM steps and calls summarized here. These instrumented runs may overlap compilers and are excluded from timing comparisons.
